item.description:
• Editor and preview now scroll together; Markdown aligns by block, other formats by position
  • Double-click a paragraph, heading, list item, table cell or code block in the Markdown preview to edit it in place
  • The sidebar can be resized, and collapses to an icon-only strip when dragged narrow; double-click the divider to toggle
  • Confirmation dialogs keep a single-line title so buttons stay in place

• 编辑与预览两侧同步滚动；Markdown 按段落对齐，其它格式按比例对齐
  • Markdown 预览中双击段落、标题、列表项、表格单元格或代码块可直接改字，改动写回源码
  • 侧边栏可拖动调整宽度，拖窄后变为仅显示图标的精简版，双击分隔线切换
  • 确认对话框标题固定单行，按钮位置不再随文件名长度变化
